roads.name: Gateway Motorway (Murarrie toll point, covers Gateway Bridge)
roads.note: Linkt lists a single Gateway Motorway point at Murarrie. No separate Gateway Extension price was found; treat it as covered by this point.

roads.name: Logan Motorway (Kuraby / Compton Road)
roads.note: Linkt page lists this point without naming the road; it is on the Logan Motorway corridor (assignment from general knowledge).

roads.name: Logan Motorway (Heathwood / Paradise Road)
roads.note: Linkt lists Heathwood and Paradise Road at the same $3.76; road assignment inferred. Which points a route crosses depends on direction and entry, so a route-level match by name is approximate.

roads.name: AirportlinkM7 (Bowen Hills to Kedron or Toombul)
roads.note: Bowen Hills to Kedron or Toombul $7.16; Kedron to Toombul only $5.36. Adjusts on 1 January 2027.
